title: When the KV Cache Is Slower Than the GPU: Scaling Remote KV Tiers for Context-Parallel Prefill
abstract: arXiv:2610.21500v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reusing the attention KV cache across requests is a standard way to cut prefill cost in long-context LLM serving, and production systems increasingly back the per-engine cache with a remote tier shared by every engine. We study such a tier in a disaggregated deployment of GLM-5.3, an FP8 mixture-of-experts model with multi-head latent attention (MLA), on 8xB300 nodes running prefill context parallelism (PCP8). Enabling the remote tier (LMCache with a Valkey store) left median time-to-first-token unchanged but raised the 16k-token p99 from 3.96 s to 17.3 s. Replaying a production request stream on an isolated engine, we find that a remote hit took 0.88 s against 0.31 s to recompute the prompt, and that synchronous loading turned a hit-heavy stream into an unstable queue: p99 83.32 s with the GPUs 7% busy. translated_title: 当KV缓存比GPU更慢时：为上下文并行预填充扩展远程KV缓存层
translated_abstract: 跨请求复用注意力的KV缓存是降低长上下文LLM服务中预填充成本的标准做法，生产系统越来越多地在每引擎缓存之外配备一个由所有引擎共享的远程层。我们在GLM-5.3（一个采用FP8混合专家架构和多头潜在注意力（MLA）的模型）的分离式部署中，研究了这样一个远程层，硬件为8xB300节点，运行预填充上下文并行（PCP8）。启用远程层（采用带Valkey存储的LMCache）后，中位首个token生成时间（TTFT）保持不变，但16k token请求的p99延迟从3.96秒上升到17.3秒。通过在隔离引擎上重放生产请求流，我们发现一次远程命中耗时0.88秒，而重新计算提示词仅需0.31秒；并且同步加载使一个以命中为主的请求流变成了不稳定的队列：p99延迟高达83.32秒，而GPU利用率仅为7%。一个两项成本模型解释了这两种现象：只有当远程层提供超过B* = sR的带宽时（对于该模型和GPU约为2.53 GB/s），缓存命中才能带来收益。（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 在长上下文LLM服务中，远程KV缓存层必须提供超过约2.5 GB/s的临界带宽（B* = sR）才能比重算提示词更快，否则缓存命中反而更慢，且同步加载会让GPU几乎闲置、p99尾延迟从4秒暴涨至83秒。
en_tdlr: A remote KV-cache tier only beats recomputation when its bandwidth exceeds a critical threshold B* = sR (~2.53 GB/s for GLM-5.3 on B300 GPUs); otherwise synchronous loading leaves GPUs nearly idle (7% busy) and drives p99 latency from 3.96 s to 83.32 s.
